mapper.insert: INSERT INTO coordinator_agent_run (business_id, tenant_id, project_id, message_id, run_key, context_json, business_session_id) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{projectId}, #{messageId}, #{runKey}, #{contextJson}, #{businessSessionId})
mapper.select: SELECT id AS database_id, business_id, session_id, stage, status, last_sequence, context_json, business_session_id, invalid_output, output_json FROM coordinator_agent_run WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND run_key = #{runKey}
mapper.update: UPDATE coordinator_agent_run SET session_id = #{sessionId}, stage = #{stage}, status = 'RUNNING', last_sequence = 0, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE business_id = #{id} AND session_id IS NULL
UPDATE coordinator_agent_run SET status = 'FAILED', output_json = #{output}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE business_id = #{id}
